MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The single pack of VELCRO felt useful for a small removable mounting job on a smooth surface, which connects to my recent wall anchors and mounting supplies.",
    "The mounting connection made sense to me because it offered another way to attach something, with a quantity I could reasonably use."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Electrical coating, epoxy, cutting wheels and lubricant each solve a specific repair problem I have not shown a need for; buying fasteners does not mean I need every kind of repair supply.",
    "The nut assortment does not fit the nails and wood screws I recently chose, since those do not need nuts. The thermometer and caliper also require tasks I do not currently have.",
    "The duct tape packs contain far more tape than I need, and tape would not serve the same purpose as my recent fasteners."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in fastening and mounting seems to have been stretched into a broad interest in tools and maintenance products.",
    "My purchases of large packs of nails and screws seem to have been taken as a reason to offer bulk supplies generally, although quantity only makes sense when I need that particular item."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The intended job matters: fastening wood, mounting something removably and repairing electrical insulation are different needs even when the supplies are used around the home.",
    "Fit and specifications matter to me, as reflected in the particular nail angles, screw sizes and vacuum bag types in my history.",
    "My medicine cups and replacement vacuum bags reflect separate practical needs; they do not imply that I am pursuing one broad repair project."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "You recognized my interest in practical mounting supplies but extended it too broadly to products for unrelated maintenance tasks."
}
